scope: Receive-side synthetic held-out aperture benchmark; no spacecraft command/uplink implementation.

scenario.note: Separate conservative benchmark scenario. Do not mix directly with the page historical sandbox antenna-gain default.

robust_classical.method: STFT power normalized by per-frame median noise floor; 17-slope de-drift track max; 35th-percentile time winsorisation selected on a separate validation seed.

mixed_split_transformer_reference_50pct.note: Interpolation between measured 45% and 55% carrier-fraction held-out sweeps of the mixed-split transformer.

neural.components: mixed-split transformer detector + learned (7,4) encoder/transformer decoder

fixed_50_50_whole_receiver.limiting_stage: decoder for both methods at the 8 b/s reference rate

hypothetical_waveform_redesign.constraint: carrier fraction >= 0.10 in the measured neural sweep

robust_classical_analytic.note: Carrier-track detection scaling from the measured 50/50 point, combined analytically with measured Hamming decoder requirement; not a separate held-out split sweep.

hypothetical_waveform_redesign.operational_caveat: Pioneer 6 center frequency and onboard modulation/power split are spacecraft-fixed. This section is a hypothetical future-radio design study, not a control available for Pioneer 6.

physics_limit.shannon_note: No learned method changes Shannon capacity. Gains reported here recover implementation/coding margin toward the same physical limit.
